data.name: Tower Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Step into the chilling realm of Tower Survivors, a dark fantasy survival RTS that immerses you in a desperate struggle against relentless evil.

Embark on a solo journey or team up with allies, with 4-player battles exploding into fierce PvP showdowns across three haunting realms: Anubis Tomb, Jurassic Valley, and Vampire Monastery.

Every player wields a one-time nuke to turn the tide, while your tower strikes passively as you strategize shop buys and trigger the adrenaline-fueled rush mode to accelerate all units!

Encounter a roster of awe-inspiring units that demand your attention!

In Jurassic Valley, face the ferocious T-Rex, the earth-shaking Brontosaurus, primal Men, and the colossal Mammoth —savage beasts charging from a lost era.

Anubis Tomb strikes with the multi-headed Hydra, relentless Slaves, the towering Anubis Statue, and the devastating Sphinxapult —ancient terrors fueled by divine wrath.

Vampire Monastery unleashes the grotesque Abomination, the feral Werewolf, the wailing Banshee, the stone-winged Gargoyle and the fire-breathing Death Drake —undead legions rising to haunt your every move.

Each faction’s unique units and traits will test your courage in epic, unforgettable battles!

Harness the power of 8 elemental forces—Chaos, Fire, Frost, Lightning, Physical, Poison, Water, Wind—to dominate the battlefield!

Unleash a dynamic arsenal with barrage, beam, bomb, bouncing, directional, raining, siege, and toss weapons! Upgrade your tower with life-saving heals, and in the shop, invest in income for steady gold, repairs to mend your tower, or health to boost max HP.

And unleash the universal one-time nuke to wipe out all enemies!

Team up or clash in intense 4-player peer-to-peer hosted games across the 3 levels!

Versus Mode: Ruthless survival PvP—outlast rivals against endless hordes. Use the rush button as a weapon against your opponents, speeding units to overwhelm and destroy enemy towers. Last tower standing wins!

Normal Mode: Chill co-op vibes—unite against the waves, for those chill sessions with your friends!

Conquer epic challenges to unlock 23 stunning tower skins! Prove your prowess by slaying an Archangel, achieving a maximum killing spree, or enduring 60 minutes using only one element.

Each skin transforms your tower with a unique flair, while hidden treasures await the boldest warriors!

data.short_description: 'Tower Survivors' is a dark fantasy survival RTS where you must survive, upgrade and defend humanity against massive unending armies from Anubis Tomb, Jurassic Valley and Vampire Monastery. Set in three different empires hell-bent on your destruction, it’s not if you can survive, but how long.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU, 2.5 GHz (Intel Core i5-4430 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU with 4GB VRAM GTX 960 / RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
